name: Quote generation - revise quantity after first quote
description: Customer requests a quote for 10 sheets, then asks to revise to 25 sheets. AI should generate a new quote with the updated quantity.

messages.text: Hi, my name is Test Customer. Please quote me for 10 sheets of white melamine 16mm

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a quote total with R prefix
Quote should be generated (quote_total populated or PDF URL in reply)
Quote generation may take up to 30 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
No internal optimizer variable names in reply

notes: Two-message scenario testing quote revision. AI should generate_quote on first message, then re-generate with updated quantity on the second. 10s delay between messages.
